integrity: The vertex characterization is independently supported by the half-integrality/odd-cycle criterion and explicit clique tight equalities. Exact distance-by-support-size formulas reduce the enclosure problem to a two-orbit crossing. A positive barycentric representation of all active contacts certifies minimum radius and uniqueness for every dimension. Independent finite solves are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: This result concerns the standard edge-relaxation fractional stable-set polytope of complete graphs with Euclidean coordinates. It does not apply to the stronger clique-inequality relaxation, general graphs, affine images, or the inscribed-ball problem. The oldest vertex-description paper is used as supporting literature and predates the focal 2017 source.
title: Complete-graph fractional stable-set polytopes have a sharp seven-dimensional sphere transition
